description: Feature 3.6 dashboard cache key contract — from actual Feature 3.4 + page source

layers.layer: Feature 3.4 dashboard_cache.py (available, not imported by the Trends page)
layers.data_loader: load_trend_dataset_cached() → st.cache_data, key = source path + SHA-256 fingerprint (get_source_fingerprint)
layers.version_source: _get_source_version_key(): path@sha8 or path@mtime fallback, or 'unavailable' (safe conservative invalidate)
layers.invalidation: source path or SHA-256 change → new key → recompute

layers.layer: Frontend pages/4_Trends.py (the page actually in use)
layers.agg_key: implicit (entire aggregation computed inside the cached function)
layers.invalidation: path change or Streamlit cache clear or process restart. Content change at same path is NOT detected.
layers.returns_copy: dicts are fresh per call within cache entry; page does not mutate them
layers.note: Path-only keying is acceptable because the source dataset is immutable during a demo session. Content-change invalidation is weaker than Feature 3.4's SHA-256 key — documented, not changed.

key_correctness_rules: same source + same params → cache reuse
changed source identity (different path or version) → must not reuse stale aggregate
source content change at same path: page layer does not detect (accepted for immutable demo dataset); Feature 3.4 layer detects via SHA-256
